certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Official Arkansas Secretary of State TotalResults ENR API for the 2024 General Election. The parser reads the federal contest result payload for U.S. President, maps county location ids from the election info payload, and reconciles county candidate sums against the official statewide contest totals.

reviewCharts.coverageNote: Official Arkansas Secretary of State TotalResults federal contest calls with county locationID parameters expose presidential local reporting-unit rows across all 75 counties. Down-ballot flags are suppressed in this pass.

certifiedResults.title: Arkansas official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are parsed from the official Arkansas Secretary of State TotalResults ENR API for the 2024 General Election. The parser uses the contest list for candidate ids, election info for county names, and the federal contest results payload for county vote totals.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Arkansas Secretary of State TotalResults API payload lastUpdated timestamp for election ID 1846.

wardDetail.title: Arkansas official local vote-share review
wardDetail.detail: Official Arkansas Secretary of State TotalResults federal contest calls with county locationID parameters expose presidential local reporting-unit rows across all 75 counties. The app loads these rows for vote-share advisory review and suppresses down-ballot flags until same-grain comparison rows are mapped safely.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Arkansas TotalResults county-scoped federal contest API payloads expose local reporting-unit presidential locations and share the election lastUpdated timestamp.

turnout.title: Arkansas turnout denominator
turnout.detail: Official Arkansas Secretary of State TotalResults election-info payload supplies statewide registered voters, total ballots cast, and turnout percent. County-level registered-voter denominators are not exposed in the loaded source, so coverage is labeled statewide-only.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Arkansas TotalResults election-info payload lastUpdated timestamp for election ID 1846; denominator timing is still labeled unknown because no page-posted denominator timing note is captured.
